Signalsmith Stretch (MIT) and the two headers of Signalsmith Linear it needs (stft.h, fft.h; MIT),
kept unchanged, as Giannitune (AGPL-3.0, https://github.com/jonnygucci1/Giannitune) uses them for its
pitch shifting. KNAY Studio's VariAudio renders edited vocals with it (bridge.cpp).
